title: How to Read World Switch Log Registers

c.v: By reading World Switch Log Registers, we get to understand the information of previous world switches and nested interrupts, thus being able to restore to previous world.
Steps are described below: (See Figure 16.5-4 as an example):
Read Register WCL_CORE_m_STATUSTABLE_CURRENT_REG, and understand CPU is now at the interrupt monitored at Entry 4.
Read 1 from Field WCL_CORE_m_FROM_ENTRY_4, and understand the CPU was at an interrupt monitored at Entry 1.
Read 9 from Field WCL_CORE_m_FROM_ENTRY_1, and understand the CPU was at an interrupt monitored at Entry 9.
Read 0 from WCL_CORE_m_FROM_ENTRY_9, and understand CPU wasn't at any interrupt.
Then read 1 from WCL_CORE_m_FROM_WORLD_9, and understand CPU was in Non-secure World at the beginning.
